title: Fly, Drive, Reconfigure: A Modular Reconfigurable Aerial-Ground Platform for Field Operations
summary: Heterogeneous robot teams distribute complementary capabilities across specialized agents, but their physical roles and capacities typically remain fixed throughout a mission. We present HARP, a Heterogeneous Aerial Robotic modules Platform in which independently deployable aerial robots physically reconfigure to compose their capabilities for field operations.
